changelog:
Massgram 12.5.5

- Added an owner-only Massgram dashboard with total users, active now, offline counts and a searchable user list.
- Added a lightweight once-per-minute heartbeat while the app is open to power Massgram online and offline status in the dashboard.
- Heartbeat sends Telegram user ID, username or display name, app version, build channel, device model, Android version and locale.
- Heartbeat does not send chat history, message text, media, contacts or call audio.
